# Batch 1 word verification: Wiktionary (2026-10-09)

Method:
- Raw wikitext gave the entry, POS and gloss.
- The rendered page `https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/<word>` gave the expanded {{lo-pron}} IPA.
- Both passes went through WebFetch's summarizer, so exact characters should be spot-checked.

**Important caveat.** Wiktionary's Lao IPA is generated by `Module:lo-pron` from the spelling, using the same 5-tone matrix as our SCHEMA. Agreement with our derivation therefore confirms that the spelling and the rule were applied consistently. It is **not** independent evidence of the spoken tone. Rule exceptions (if any exist in Vientiane speech) would not show up here.
